{{Quote|The canned edu-packs can teach a soldier only so much. These commanders need the guidance only seasoned combat veterans can provide.|Alpha|<ref name="HNN 15:2:22" />}}
The '''ARC program''', also known as '''ARC training''' or the '''ARC training program''', was an advanced [[Officer/Legends|officer]] training program for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]] and other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] officers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Established by the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], the program was overseen by Alpha and other ARC [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].

==Description==
{{Quote|There's a galaxy of difference. Sure, we understand that the neural pumps give us what feel like authentic combat memories, but having the ARC drill sergeants making it real and overseeing the simulations gives us the edge over the previous units.|Commander Thire, graduate of the ARC training program|<ref name="HNN 15:2:22" />}}
The program constituted grueling training, with the goal being individuality and independence. Participants were rewarded with the right to take nicknames, to be used instead of their numerical designations.<ref name="DB clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref>

Training took place within the first few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the war, with the first class of one hundred graduates being ready by approximately [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Some graduates went on to form the elite [[Squad Seven (Galactic Republic)|Squad Seven]].<ref name="New FF 2: Cody" />
